description: A6 language rule (BI-PF-0395) enforcing the LOCKED delivery baseline (BI-PF-0387/0388): new shipped/sensitive logic must land in Go; existing shipped Python stays compiled (edits allowed, new modules blocked); build-time tooling may stay Python. READ by core/change_policy.py (single reader); enforced by scripts/dev/language_rule_check.py (author-time + precheck). Roots are reviewed config - changing them is a governance change.
